notes: tier is the OPERATOR grade and it is PER MAPPING — this rival against THIS product of ours. The same rival is legitimately Beatable for one of our listings and Aspirational for another. null means UNGRADED, which is not a tier and must never be read as one.
Rows are ordered by estimated weekly sales, highest first; a rival with no estimate sorts LAST — unmeasured is not zero.
price, reviews, rating, bsr and the promo columns are the LATEST weekly scrape, dated by weekStartDate. salesBand is the X-Ray bracket, a range, never a point.
us[] is our own row for the same product and marketplace — the baseline priceIndex was computed against.
